title: The support of a face current lies on the closed faces with nonzero density
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1. Let s be a finite set of pairs p = (ι, b), where ι : Fin n → Fin P is arbitrary and b : Fin P → ℤ. Let w_p : Euclid n → ℝ be Lebesgue integrable on Q₁ := {y ∈ Euclid n : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i} for every p ∈ s. Write e_l := EuclideanSpace.single l 1 ∈ Euclid P, Φ_p(y) := WithLp.toLp 2 (i ↦ (b i : ℝ)) + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)} and E_p := (e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(m)}). Let D ∈ GeometricCurrentOn univ n satisfy D(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} w_p(y)·ω(Φ_p(y))(E_p) dy for every test n-form ω. Then every x ∈ spt D, where D.support = univ ∖ zeroRegion D (Simon 6.2.11), equals Φ_p(y) for some p ∈ s with ∫_{Q₁} |w_p| ≠ 0 and some y ∈ [0,1]ⁿ (0 ≤ y_i ≤ 1 for all i).
